title: Easy to Use and Reliable
text: Easy to Use and Reliable. I've had this for awhile now and I haven't had any issues. I've even have a roommate that regularly uses this as well.  It's easy to set up/break down and small enough when broken down that it fits perfectly in my closet.  I haven't had any problems with it and it seems to always have enough space for my dresses, pants, and whatever else I need to hang dry.
